task_title: Autonomous resumable curation of the complete English Bible (66 books, 1,189 chapters)
result: PASS — resumable queue executed for all 66 books; every job validated and checkpointed; book-level canonical/edition/locale v2 packages merged; cross-book reconciliation (per book and canon) written; the Zod package contract validates all 66 books; importer dry run passes.
user_visible_outcome: The English BSB canon now has machine-generated draft v2 packages with meaningful passage boundaries, people, places, relationships, structural events, attestations, passage relevance, book/chapter/passage contexts and exact BSB mention selectors. Every one of the 66 books and 1,189 chapters has an explicit coverage result, and every verse is either complete_with_records or complete_zero. Nothing is approved or published.

approach.queue: tools/curate_canon_queue.py defines jobs as bounded contiguous chapter groups (never splitting a chapter), resumes from per-job checkpoints under content/curation/queue/bsb/, validates each job before merging into the book packages, and is retryable without repeating or modifying completed jobs.
approach.sources: BSB bundled text and section headings; BibleData Person/PersonRelationship/PersonVerse (CC BY 4.0); OpenBible ancient places (CC BY 4.0); authored book knowledge tools/whole_bible_knowledge.json.
approach.identity: Reuses the global registry content/curated/registry/entities.json. 7,728 entities resolved_existing; 0 created_new_canonical; 19 uncertain identities kept as unresolved candidates with no attestations.
approach.no_filler: Unsupported historical/chronological/interpretive orientation remains blocking open questions, never invented prose. Event records are structural projections of BSB headings with attested participants and carry no independent historical claim.

files_changed: tools/curate_canon_queue.py (new: resumable queue, per-job validation, merge, reconciliation, coverage)

validation.job_schema_dependency_identifier_anchor_: 335/335 jobs valid (envelope versions/layer/family, registry digest, key grammar, word-bounded BSB anchor resolution with occurrence ordinal and 20-char prefix/suffix, per-verse mention non-overlap).
validation.book_level: 66/66 books pass the book validator (coverage partition of every book verse, relationships/events/profile/localization/question reference closure, unique keys).
validation.contract_zod: packages/content-schema jest: 8 suites, 254 tests passed, including wholeBibleGenerated for all 66 BSB books (and the unchanged Telugu corpus).
validation.deterministic_generation: Regenerating Gen with --force reproduced byte-identical canonical/edition/locale packages.
validation.preview_drift: npm run verify:preview -> preview asset is up to date.
validation.repo: root typecheck exit 0; root lint exit 0; npx prettier --check . -> 3 known pre-existing warnings (AGENTS.md, apps/mobile/expo-env.d.ts, .claude/settings.local.json).

unresolved_ambiguities.policy: Source persons whose notes/unique_attribute explicitly signal uncertainty ("possibly the same as", "likely the same", "may be") are emitted as unresolved candidates with no attestations, relevance, profiles or mentions.
unresolved_ambiguities.ambiguous_mention_spans_dropped: Surface forms shared or nested between two entities in one verse (e.g. person Haran / place Haran; person David / place City of David) are dropped rather than guessed; the verse keeps an explicit complete_zero result. Recorded per book in editorial_observations (code ambiguous-mention-referents-dropped).

known_limitations: No importer exists for the whole-Bible draft packages; the only available importer dry run is Nehemiah-2 (tools/import-neh2.py --check). The canon packages are not wired to a staging import.
Historical, chronological and interpretive orientation stays a blocking open question wherever the allowed inputs do not support it; those contexts report blocked, not filler.
Event records are deterministic projections of BSB section headings plus attested participants/places; they are not independently sourced event identities and carry no historical claim.
Objects, roles, practices, terms, themes, maps and chronology are not fabricated and remain uncurated.
Machine-generated drafts only: no independent review, approval or publication occurred; content/curation/whole-bible-status.json was not rewritten.
Task scoped to the English BSB canon; the Telugu IRV corpus under content/curated/tel is unchanged.
stop_condition: Stopped after all 66 books / 1,189 chapters / 31,086 verses had explicit coverage, every job and book validated, the full-canon reconciliation completed, and the Zod contract tests plus importer dry run passed. No review, approval or publication was performed.
